raw.description: The application does not implement CSRF protection for the GET request to fetch the profile data.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into visiting a malicious site that makes a GET request to the /profile endpoint, potentially exposing sensitive information.

raw.description: The application does not implement CSRF protection for the login POST request.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into submitting a login request to the application, potentially logging the attacker into the user's account.

raw.description: The application does not implement CSRF protection for the profile update PUT request.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into submitting a profile update request, potentially changing the user's profile information.

raw.description: The application does not implement CSRF protection for the registration POST request.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into submitting a registration request, potentially creating a new account without the user's consent.

raw.description: The application uses a hardcoded JWT secret, which is not securely stored.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code could use the JWT secret to forge tokens and impersonate users.

raw.description: The application does not use parameterized queries for the SQL SELECT statement in the login endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker could perform SQL injection by manipulating the email parameter to execute arbitrary SQL commands.

raw.description: The application does not use parameterized queries for the SQL SELECT statement in the profile endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker could perform SQL injection by manipulating the user ID to execute arbitrary SQL commands.

raw.description: The application does not use parameterized queries for the SQL UPDATE statement in the profile update endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker could perform SQL injection by manipulating the username or email parameters to execute arbitrary SQL commands.

raw.description: The application directly renders user data without escaping it, potentially leading to reflected XSS.
raw.exploit: An attacker could inject malicious scripts into the username or email fields, which would be executed when viewed by another user.
